title: Visibility filtering on state sync
description: Server currently sends full game state to all players including hidden and private information. Implement per-player state filtering based on zone visibility declarations (public/private/hidden). Private zones only visible to owner. Hidden zones omitted from all client responses (count only). Must filter in both state_sync and move_confirmed messages.
close_reason: Promoted filter_for_viewer from engine test to library (engine/src/visibility.rs). Wired into server: initial state_sync, MoveConfirmed (per-player FilteredBroadcast), and StateSync reply all now filter based on zone visibility. Hidden zones stripped to count only, private zones visible only to owner.
